pages.text:
Joy. Thrills. Adventure. Pick Three.
Meet the 2013 Suzuki SX4. A car that just makes you want to pick a point on the
map and go. And isn’t that what driving happiness is all about? The SX4 offers three
stylish models to choose from: There’s the versatile All-Wheel Drive (AWD) Crossover,
the Euro-inspired SportBack and the sophisticated Sport sedan. Each model proves
in its own way that a well-equipped ride doesn’t have to break the bank.
2
